summary: Wrote a single-phase plan to add one public import line for Intuitionistic.Scheme to Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Tableau/Intuitionistic.lean, positioned between Soundness and Completeness per the dependency chain. The change is provably inert (transitive closure unchanged), so verification is targeted-build-only plus mk_all/checkInitImports/lint-style/shake-residue checks. Cslib.lean is explicitly out of scope.
decisions_made: Sized as one phase, 0.5 hours: the change is one file, one added line.
Cslib.lean is out of scope -- it is mk_all-generated and CI-enforced exhaustive; editing it would break CI.

Verification Tier is local: no symbol signature changes (interface inapplicable), and a full lake build stalls on Intuitionistic/Scheme.lean so full is operationally ruled out; the import-graph blind spot is closed by explicit mk_all/checkInitImports/shake checks.
A Scope Hypothesis requires the implementer to confirm git diff --stat reports exactly 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+).
Shake residue must be confirmed with --list, never silently baselined with --update.
dead_ends: Dropping the direct Scheme line from Cslib.lean -- breaks the CI imports test and would be re-added by the next mk_all run.
Adding a 'deliberately excluded' comment instead of the import -- no evidence of deliberate exclusion; Scheme is cited from six other files and the test suite.
Normalizing the other 12 partial barrels under Cslib/Logics/ -- partial barrels are widespread and this would become an unscoped refactor.
Running a bare lake build or lake env lean without --setup -- the build stalls on Intuitionistic/Scheme.lean.
